toolkit.name: Contentful
toolkit.description: Contentful is a headless CMS allowing developers to create, manage, and distribute content across multiple channels and devices with an API-first approach

space_id.title: Space Id
space_id.description: ID of the space containing the content type

environment_id.title: Environment Id

tools.name: Archive Asset

Use when you need to make an asset publicly accessible or move it from draft to published status. The asset must not be archived and should be fully processed before publishing. Publishing increments the asset version and sets publication metadata.

input.title: PublishAssetRequest

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: ID of the asset to publish

space_id.title: Space Id
space_id.description: ID of the space containing the asset

environment_id.title: Environment Id
environment_id.description: ID of the environment containing the asset (typically 'master')

X-Contentful-Version.title: X Contentful Version
X-Contentful-Version.description: Version of the asset to publish. Required for version control. Use the current version number of the asset.

input.description: Request model for publishing an asset in Contentful.

tools.name: Publish Entry
tools.description: Tool to publish an entry in Contentful, making it available via the Content Delivery API. Use when you need to make an entry publicly accessible or move it from draft to published status. The entry must not be archived and should have all required fields completed. Publishing increments the entry version.

entry_id.title: Entry Id
entry_id.description: ID of the entry to publish

space_id.title: Space Id
space_id.description: ID of the space containing the entry

environment_id.title: Environment Id
environment_id.description: ID of the environment containing the entry (typically 'master')

X-Contentful-Version.title: X Contentful Version
X-Contentful-Version.description: Version of the entry to publish. Required for version control. Use the current version number of the entry.

input.description: Request model for publishing an entry in Contentful.

tools.name: Query Asset Collection
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple assets with pagination and filtering via GraphQL API. Use when you need to query assets from Contentful with advanced filtering, sorting, and locale selection. Supports preview mode and fallback locale options.

input.title: QueryAssetCollectionRequest

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: Zero-indexed offset in the collection from which items are fetched. Default is 0

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to fetch. Default is 100, maximum is 1000

order.title: Order
order.description: Order specifications to apply on the collection query. Example: ['sys_firstPublishedAt_ASC', 'sys_id_DESC']

where.title: Where
where.description: Filter specifications to apply on the collection query (AssetFilter type). Example: {'contentType': 'image/jpeg'}

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale for the collection items. If not set, the default locale is used. Example: 'en-US'

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: When set to true, returns non-published content. Default is false

tools.name: Query GraphQL Content Type Collection
tools.description: Tool to query a collection of entries for a specific content type using GraphQL. Use when you need to fetch multiple entries with filtering, sorting, pagination, or preview mode. The query field name must be the camelCase content type ID with 'Collection' suffix (e.g., 'blogPostCollection').

space_id.title: Space Id
